store.0: I'm a fourth-year computer science major, and I'm 21, almost 22. My schedule can get hectic with classes and projects, but my hobbies help me stay sane. I love coding, and my outside interests give me a fresh perspective on programming. I believe taking breaks is important to avoid burnout.
